name: TassHunting
description: Hunting overhaul and tweaks to make the game feel a bit more realistic and alive. Arrows that stick in targets; Arrow break chance modifiers and pickup arrow heads instead of them being destroyed, more aggressive predators, blood trails, bloody water, health based animal run speed, damage over time bleed effects, better close combat bow aiming and accuracy, longer audible footstep range of predators, animals flee from longer range and flee away from you more realistically, faster harvest loot and auto drop loot, and config lib ui support to tweak in-game.
